docs.description: Hand-written tool with a mixed (bare-literal + struct) union (`quality_check = Literal[0] | QcOn`) whose struct arm owns an output-file (the ants antsIntroduction.sh `n4_correction` / `quality_check` shape). The output is gated on the struct variant, so the emitter renders a `@type` check on the union value - which is a non-indexable type error (and a runtime KeyError on the literal arm) unless a shape guard (`isinstance` dict / `typeof === object`) narrows off the bare-literal arm first.
